name: emberfall-card-game
description: Emberfall: single-player fantasy card battles, responsive UI and offline rules

scripts.test:release: npm run build && npm test && npm run test:e2e
scripts.format: prettier --write src/content src/rules src/presentation src/platform src/data.js src/engine.js src/ui.js
scripts.vendor:vesper: esbuild tools/vesper-three-entry.js --bundle --format=iife --global-name=EmberVesperThree --minify --legal-comments=none --outfile=src/vendor/vesper-three.js && node -e "const f='src/vendor/vesper-three.js',fs=require('fs');fs.writeFileSync(f,'/* three.js '+JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('node_modules/three/package.json')).version+' (MIT, see src/vendor/vesper-three.LICENSE.txt), bundled by npm run vendor:vesper */\n'+fs.readFileSync(f))"
